model_family: WFW5720 4.5 cu. ft. Smart Front Load ENERGY STAR Washer with FreshFlow Vent System
sticker_location: Open the washer door and look inside the door, on the rim of the round opening.

parts.label: power cord
parts.where: Plugs into the wall outlet behind the washer.

parts.label: drain pump filter
parts.where: At the bottom front of the washer, behind the small flap or bottom drawer.

parts.label: small black drain hose
parts.where: Next to the drain pump filter, behind the bottom front flap.

parts.label: detergent drawer
parts.where: Top left front of the washer, above the door. Pull it toward you.

parts.label: gray door seal
parts.where: The gray rubber ring around the round door opening.

parts.label: washer door
parts.where: The large round glass door on the front of the washer.

parts.label: washer drum
parts.where: The big metal tub you put clothes in, behind the door.

parts.label: cycle knob
parts.where: On the front control panel above the door.

parts.label: start button
parts.where: On the front control panel, marked Start/Pause.

parts.label: control lock button
parts.where: On the front control panel, marked Control Lock or shown with a lock sign.

parts.label: leveling feet
parts.where: Four small feet under the bottom corners of the washer.

parts.label: water inlet hoses
parts.where: Two hoses at the back of the washer, joining it to the wall taps.

parts.label: main drain hose
parts.where: The thick hose at the back that goes into the wall pipe or sink.

parts.label: water taps
parts.where: Hot and cold taps on the wall behind the washer.

symptoms: Water is still in the drum
Clothes are soaking wet at the end

plan.diagnosis: Water cannot get out fast enough, often because the drain pump filter is blocked with lint or small items. Checking the drain hose position also helps, as a hose pushed too far down can cause trouble.
safety: Turn the washer off and unplug it before opening the filter.
Expect water to come out, so keep the pan and towel ready.
Do not run the washer with the filter out.

steps.instruction: Turn washer off and unplug it
details: Wait until the drum has stopped moving.
steps.check: The lights on the panel are off and the plug is out.

steps.instruction: Put flat pan under bottom front flap
details: The flap is low on the front.
A towel under the pan catches spills.
steps.check: The pan sits flat under the bottom front area.

steps.instruction: Pull black hose out and remove plug
details: Let the water run into the pan.
Put the plug back when water stops.
steps.check: Water has drained into the pan and the plug is back in.

steps.instruction: Twist filter left and lift it out
details: Turn slowly, more water may drip out.
If stuck, wiggle gently, do not force it.
steps.check: The round filter is out in your hand.

steps.instruction: Rinse filter under tap and remove lint
details: Pick off coins, hair grips and lint by hand.
steps.check: You can see through the filter and no lint is left.

steps.instruction: Twist filter right until handle stands upright
details: Push it fully in first.
Turn until it stops and the handle is upright.
steps.check: The filter handle is upright and will not turn more.

steps.instruction: Check main drain hose sits loosely in pipe
details: Only the end should go into the pipe.
Do not tape it tightly into the pipe.
steps.check: The hose end is in the pipe but not pushed far down.

symptoms: Black marks inside the door seal

plan.diagnosis: Soap and dirt build up inside the drum and door seal and cause the smell. A monthly Clean Washer cycle and wiping the seal usually clears it.
safety: Do not mix bleach with other cleaners.
Keep the cleaner tablet away from children.
Leave the door open only where children and pets are supervised.

steps.instruction: Take all clothes out of drum
details: Check pockets and the seal folds too.
steps.check: The drum is completely empty.

steps.instruction: Put cleaning tablet directly into drum
details: Put it in the drum, not the drawer.
steps.check: The tablet sits at the bottom of the empty drum.

steps.instruction: Close door firmly until it clicks
steps.check: The door stays shut when you let go.

steps.instruction: Choose Clean Washer cycle on knob
details: Turn the knob until Clean Washer lights up.
steps.check: Clean Washer is shown on the panel.

steps.instruction: Hold start button until cycle starts
details: Hold for about three seconds.
steps.check: The door locks and the cycle begins.

steps.instruction: Wipe gray seal folds with damp cloth
details: Pull the seal back gently to reach inside.
Pick out lint and small items.
steps.check: The seal folds look clean and dry.

steps.instruction: Leave door open after cycle ends
details: A small gap is enough to let it dry.
steps.check: The door is left open a little.

symptoms: Water puddle in front of washer
Floor is wet after a wash

plan.diagnosis: Front leaks often come from a dirty door seal, something stuck in the seal, or a drawer that is clogged or not fully closed. Cleaning these parts usually stops the drip.
safety: Turn off the water taps if water is flowing out.
Unplug the washer before reaching under the seal.
Mop up water so nobody slips.

steps.instruction: Turn off both water taps behind washer
details: Turn both taps until they stop.
steps.check: Both taps are turned fully off.

steps.instruction: Pull seal back and wipe it clean
details: Use a damp cloth around the whole ring.
Clean the glass where it touches the seal.
steps.check: No hair, lint or grit is left on the seal.

steps.instruction: Remove stuck items from under seal
details: Feel slowly around the folds with your fingers.
Look for socks, coins and hair grips.
steps.check: The seal folds are empty and the small holes are clear.

steps.instruction: Pull detergent drawer out toward you
details: Press the release tab and pull straight out.
steps.check: The drawer is out in your hand.

steps.instruction: Rinse drawer under tap and wipe dry
details: Scrub off old soap with a cloth.
Dispensers are not dishwasher safe.
steps.check: The drawer looks clean with no soap lumps.

steps.instruction: Slide drawer back until fully closed
details: Line it up with the guides and push gently.
steps.check: The drawer front sits flush with the washer.

steps.instruction: Turn taps on and run short wash
details: Watch the door and drawer for drips.
steps.check: No water drips from the door or drawer.

plan.diagnosis: The washer is probably not level, or one foot is not firmly on the floor. A single heavy item or a tightly packed load can also make it bang.
tools: spirit level or phone level app
safety: Unplug the washer before adjusting the feet.
Get another adult to help tip or hold the washer.
Do not put hands under a tipped washer.

steps.instruction: Take clothes out and close door
details: An empty washer is easier to check.
steps.check: The drum is empty and the door is shut.

steps.instruction: Rock washer corner to corner by hand
details: Push gently at the top corners.
If it rocks, a foot needs adjusting.
steps.check: You can tell if the washer rocks or sits firm.

steps.instruction: Place level across top front edge
details: Check side to side, then front to back.
steps.check: The level shows which side is low.

steps.instruction: Turn low foot with wrench to level
details: Turn right to lower, left to raise.
Only turn a little at a time.
steps.check: All four feet feel firmly on the floor.

steps.instruction: Tighten nut against washer bottom with wrench
details: Hold the foot still while you tighten.
This stops the foot moving later.
steps.check: The nut is tight against the bottom of the washer.

steps.instruction: Rock washer again and check level
details: Repeat the foot turning if it still rocks.
steps.check: The washer does not rock and the level looks even.

symptoms: Nothing happens when I press start

plan.diagnosis: The control lock may be on, the door may not be fully shut, or the start button was not held long enough. Water taps also need to be fully open.
safety: Do not force the door open.
Keep hands dry when plugging the washer in.

steps.instruction: Push door firmly until it clicks shut
details: Check no clothes are trapped in the seal.
steps.check: The door is shut and will not pull open.

steps.instruction: Hold control lock button three seconds
details: This turns the lock off if LoC showed.
Hold the button itself, not words below it.
steps.check: The LoC or LC sign disappears.

steps.instruction: Turn both water taps fully open
details: Both hot and cold must be on.
steps.check: Both taps are turned fully on.

steps.instruction: Hold start button for three seconds
details: Keep holding until you hear it start.
The door lock may take ten seconds.
steps.check: The door locks and the cycle starts.

steps.instruction: Unplug washer and wait five minutes
details: This resets the controls.
steps.check: The plug is out and the panel is dark.

steps.instruction: Plug washer back in and try again
details: Choose a cycle and hold start again.
steps.check: The panel lights up when plugged back in.

symptoms: Door is locked and clothes inside
Washer shows F8 E1 or Lo FL

plan.diagnosis: The washer did not sense enough water coming in, so it locked the door for safety. Pressing power starts a drain routine that can unlock it once water flow is fixed.
safety: Do not force or pry the door open.
Turn off taps if you see a leak.
Wait for the drum to stop before opening.

steps.instruction: Press power button once only
details: This starts the drain routine.
The pump may run for several minutes.
steps.check: You hear the pump running.

steps.instruction: Wait ten minutes beside the washer
details: Do not unplug it during this time.
steps.check: The pump stops and the lock light goes off.

steps.instruction: Turn both water taps fully open
details: Both hot and cold must be connected and on.
steps.check: Both taps are turned fully on.

steps.instruction: Straighten water hoses at the back
details: Smooth out any sharp bends or kinks.
Do not pull the washer out alone.
steps.check: The hoses run smoothly with no sharp bends.

steps.instruction: Pull door handle gently to open
details: Only pull when the lock light is off.
steps.check: The door opens without forcing it.

steps.instruction: Run Drain and Spin cycle empty
details: This checks water can drain away properly.
steps.check: The empty cycle finishes with no error shown.
